# Animal Crossing: Wild World Archipelago v0.1.0-alpha

Welcome to the public alpha release of Animal Crossing: Wild World for Archipelago!

This release contains the initial playable implementation of Animal Crossing: Wild World featuring museum-based progression, seasonal month progression, a custom BizHawk Master Controller, and PopTracker support.

---

## Downloads

### acww.apworld

The Archipelago world file.

Install by placing it into your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder.

---

### connector_bizhawk_acww.lua

The Lua connector used by BizHawk to communicate with the Archipelago server.

Install by placing it into your Archipelago/data/lua folder.

---

### acww_poptracker.zip

Optional PopTracker package for automatic tracking.

---

## Supported Versions

- Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer
- BizHawk 2.11.1
- Animal Crossing: Wild World (USA) (Rev 1)
- Game Code: ADME

Additional ROM revisions are planned for future releases.

---

## Features

- Catchsanity
- Museumsanity
- Journal Milestones
- Museum Percentage Milestones
- Configurable Museum Goal
- Month Progression
- High-RNG Catch Progression Exclusion
- Master Controller
- Restore AP Progress
- Recover Undonated Specimens
- Reclaim Renewable Resources
- Weed Removal
- PopTracker Support

---

This is an early alpha release.

Bug reports, balance feedback, and suggestions are greatly appreciated.
